consigne_1: Put your Merlin box into pairing mode by holding the 'transfer' button for 5s, then connect this computer to its Wi-Fi network MERLIN_....
consigne_2: During the read you lose Internet access: that's expected.
sauv_option: Back up all the box content
sauv_option_aide: Recommended. Longer, but you keep a complete copy. Cannot be done once inside the app.
ihm_brand_sub: Story studio for the Merlin box
ihm_home_ajour: Everything is up to date (last sync {d}).
ihm_home_empty_titre: This box is up to date
ihm_home_empty_p: No new story to add for {name} right now.
ihm_home_bienvenue_sum: This Merlin box was just added.
ihm_home_bienvenue_p: Browse the catalog (iTunes, Radio France) to find stories to add, or import your own audio files in "My stories".
ihm_cat_lead: Pick a source, search a series, then open it to add episodes to the active box.
ihm_ep_vide: No episode of this series can be played: the source does not (or no longer) provide the audio.
ihm_cat_offline_p: To browse the catalog, switch back to your usual Wi-Fi. The box in access-point mode cuts off Internet.
ihm_perso_lead: Add your own audio (MP3, M4A, AAC) to push onto the active box.
ihm_perso_import_sub: Click, or drop a file here (MP3, M4A, AAC)
ihm_boite_lead: Space, content and sync of the Merlin box.
ihm_boite_retirer_ok: Puts the box back to its backup of {date} ({n} files, {vol}), then removes it from Merlinus.
ihm_boite_retirer_ok_sansdate: Puts the box back to its backup ({n} files, {vol}), then removes it from Merlinus.
ihm_boite_retirer_non: No backup was made when this box was added: Merlinus can't put it back to its original state. To do so, use the speaker reset in the official Merlin app.
ihm_retrait_titre_restaurer: Restore {name} and remove it from Merlinus?
ihm_retrait_texte_restaurer: Everything Merlinus added to {name} since its backup will be erased from the box, then the box will be removed from Merlinus. Keep the box connected in access point mode throughout. The backup stays on this computer.
ihm_retrait_texte_supprimer: The box and all pending work for it will be removed from Merlinus. The content of the box itself is not changed.
ihm_retrait_encours_texte: Keep the box connected in access point mode until the end. Do not close Merlinus.
ihm_retrait_fini_texte: The box is back to the state of its backup. You can sync it again with the official Merlin app.
ihm_boite_restaurer_ok: Box removed from Merlinus. Its restore data is kept in a dated folder.
ihm_ejecte_echec: Can't disconnect the box right now. Try again in a moment.
ihm_boite_panel1_sub: What will change on the next sync.
ihm_boite_gauge_ajout: {a} MB to add · {n} MB left after sync
ihm_boite_gauge_retrait: {r} MB to remove · {n} MB left after sync
ihm_boite_gauge_mixte: {a} MB to add · {r} MB to remove · {n} MB left after sync
ihm_boite_depasse: Over capacity by {n} MB. Remove stories before syncing.
ihm_boite_hint_2: The box becomes a Wi-Fi access point.
ihm_boite_hint_3: Join the MERLIN_... network on this computer.
ihm_boite_hint_4: Come back here, then run the sync.
ihm_radio_sub_sanswifi: Radios stream over the Internet: set the home Wi-Fi first so the box can play them.
ihm_radio_sub_sans:
The box joins the “{ssid}” Wi-Fi.
Add the available radios to its tree.
ihm_radio_sub_avec:
The box joins the “{ssid}” Wi-Fi.
“Restore” puts every available radio back in the tree.
ihm_arbre_radios_vide: No radio available for this box.
ihm_wifi_sub: Network the box will join to reach the Internet (radios, updates). The box must be in access-point mode.
ihm_hor_sub: When the box is allowed to play, day by day. Drag the two handles to set start and end.
ihm_hor_nepascouper_aide: At the end time, wait for the track to finish before stopping.
ihm_boite_panel2_sub: What is present, to add or remove on the active box.
ihm_arbre_vide: This box hasn't been read yet.
ihm_sync_rien: Nothing to sync: no pending changes.
ihm_sync_verrou: Sync in progress: adding and removing will resume once it is done.
ihm_add_cat_vide: No category. Create one in the Box tab.
ihm_perso_suppr_ref: In a box's tree: remove it from the tree before deleting
ihm_ecoutes_releve: Read from the box at its last connection ({d}).
ihm_ecoutes_jamais: What the box plays will show up here after its next connection.
ihm_ecoutes_vide: Nothing played yet. The history fills up when the Merlin box tells a story, and is read at the box's next connection.
ihm_player_erreur: playback failed, the source is not responding.
illed_search_ph: Search an icon (e.g. star, cat, rocket)...
illed_hint: JPEG or PNG. It replaces the generated illustration.
err_occupee: The box is busy with another operation. Try again in a moment.
err_injoignable: Box unreachable: put it in access point mode and connect to its Wi-Fi.
err_pas_prete: The box is not responding (no reply to ping). Try again in a few seconds.
err_identite_illisible: Could not check the identity of the connected box. Try again.
err_autre_boite: The connected box is not {nom}: connect to the right box.
err_autre_boite_anonyme: The connected box is not the expected one: connect to the right box.
err_lecture_playlist: Could not read the box playlist: {detail}
err_lecture_editions: Could not read the pending changes: {detail}
err_anti_wipe: Sync refused: the box holds content Merlinus does not know (it was probably changed by the official app since the last sync). To avoid erasing it, the sync is blocked.
err_favoris: Invalid tree: {n} favorites folder(s) (exactly one expected). Sync refused.
err_arbre_degenere: Empty tree: no story to publish. Sync refused for safety.
err_export_arbre: Could not save a copy of the tree before syncing: {detail}
err_mac_chiffrement: Could not read the box identifier (needed to encrypt the playlist): {detail}
err_audio_introuvable: The audio of “{nom}” is missing from the library. Add it again before syncing.
err_illustration_introuvable: The picture of “{nom}” is missing. Add it again before syncing.
err_contenu_incomplet: “{nom}” is incomplete in the library (no audio, no picture). Add it again before syncing.
err_fichier_introuvable: A file to send is missing from the library.
err_envoi_echoue: Sending to the box failed. Check that you are connected to the box Wi-Fi, then sync again: it will resume where it stopped.
err_validation_playlist: The box could not validate the playlist. Check that you are connected to the box Wi-Fi, then try again.
err_playlist_refusee: The box rejected the playlist (status {statut}). Check the free space and try again. If the problem persists: https://github.com/louis49/merlinus
err_espace: Not enough space on the box for this sync: sending needs {besoinOctets} free, the box has {libreOctets}. Removed stories only free their space at the end of a sync: first sync the removals alone (temporarily cancel the additions), then sync the additions.
err_horaires: Could not save the time slots: {detail}
err_perso_referencee: This story is still in a box tree: remove it from the tree before deleting it.
err_assoc_mac: Box identifier (MAC) unreadable: cannot pair. Try again.
err_assoc_inventaire: Box inventory unavailable: full backup impossible ({detail}).
err_assoc_sauvegarde: Backup interrupted: {detail} (reconnect the box to resume).
err_firmware_ancien: Box firmware too old ({version}): Merlinus requires version {minimum} or later. Update the box with the publisher's mobile app, then reconnect it.
err_firmware_illisible: Box firmware version unreadable: cannot pair ({detail}). Try again.
err_resto_sans_sauvegarde: No backup of this box: cannot restore.
err_resto_mac: Could not read the box identifier: {detail}
err_resto_incomplete: Incomplete backup ({n} missing file(s), e.g. {ex}): restore refused so the box is not left poorer.
err_resto_inventaire: Could not read the box content. Try again.
err_resto_suppression: The box did not delete {nom} ({detail}). Restart the restore.
err_resto_envoi: Sending to the box failed. Check the box Wi-Fi and restart the restore: it will resume where it stopped.
err_resto_envoi_playlist: Could not send the playlist. Restart the restore.
err_resto_lecture: Could not read the box. Restart the restore.
err_resto_favoris: Could not restore the original favourites: {detail}. Restart the restore.
err_resto_ecoutes: Could not clear the listening history: {detail}. Restart the restore.
err_resto_validation: The box did not validate the restored playlist. Restart the restore.
err_resto_verif_lecture: Restore done, but the check could not read the box. Restart the restore to check.
err_resto_verif: Check: {trop} extra file(s), {manquants} missing on the box (e.g. {ex}). Restart the restore.
err_perso_suppression: Could not delete the story: {detail}. Try again in a moment.
err_resto_archivage: Restore done, but archiving the backup failed: {detail}. Restart the restore to finish.
